actual_native_failure_cause: UNRESOLVED: original stderr, exit code and frame count were not retained; they cannot be reconstructed from the sanitized trial record.

confirmed_observability_defect.stderr: _JSONLTransport._read counted bytes then discarded their content without bounded categories.
confirmed_observability_defect.exit_code: receive raised runtime_outcome_unknown on stdout EOF; wait_success (which checked native exit) was never reached without a terminal event.
confirmed_observability_defect.frame_count: The transport queued parsed objects but did not retain frame/event counters after cleanup.
confirmed_observability_defect.cleanup: The job is stopped in finally, so any later exit code may reflect our forced cleanup. It must not be attributed to the original native failure.

minimal_change.retention: StructuredRuntime.last_diagnostics is local inspection only; no automatic API, log, journal or model-prompt publication.
minimal_change.privacy: No raw stderr, text, identifiers, session IDs, paths, URLs or auth values in the snapshot. Event names map to a finite allowlist or other; stderr hints map to fixed labels or unclassified.
minimal_change.interpretation: Stderr categories are lossy hints from untrusted output, not established causes. Null pre-cleanup exit code means no exit was observable then. Undrained pipes can yield partial counters.
minimal_change.failure_semantics: No success without terminal proof and zero native exit. Unknown outcomes still poison the runtime instance; no fallback, replay or new provider start.

command_review.stdin: The entire UTF-8 prompt is written with short-write handling; stdin is closed to signal EOF. Prompt is not a command argument.
command_review.protocol: JSONL thread.started, turn.started, allowed text-only items, turn.completed and successful exit are required. Partial output and early EOF are never contributions.
command_review.environment: Case-insensitive Windows allowlist; native mode removes inherited provider API keys. No platform bearer token or database credential is forwarded.
command_review.containment: Native .exe only, shell=False, fresh temporary cwd, Windows kill-on-close job assigned before resume; finally stops owned descendants.
command_review.compatibility_limit: Existing exact-version help checks passed. Neither those checks nor current public docs establish every inline config key in 0.163.0; config rejection remains an unproven hypothesis.

offline_regressions: 12 selected tests passed: nonzero/zero/running-child EOF remains unknown, pre-cleanup exit is distinct from forced termination, secret-bearing stderr and unknown event names are not echoed, split hint recognition, synthetic Python stdin EOF, explicit session resume, no replay after failure.
stop_latch: runtime_outcome_unknown remains unchanged in the original model ledger; no fresh model journal or bypass.

retrial_proposal_for_review_only.scope: At most one fresh Codex connection challenge, only after explicit review of the unresolved outcome and remaining global budget. No Claude inference or discussion/reconnect until that result is reviewed.
retrial_proposal_for_review_only.risk: The original prompt was submitted; provider processing and billing are unknown. A new echo challenge would be a distinct new request and may duplicate work or cost. It cannot establish whether the original was processed.
retrial_proposal_for_review_only.ledger: Any approved continuation must append a separately authorized transition to the original global ledger while retaining its failed entry and stop history. Do not clear the latch, reset counts or use a replacement ledger.
retrial_proposal_for_review_only.fixture: The first credential is revoked and private fixture state removed. A continuation needs a newly scoped credential within the original total cap of three (two remain), or separately revised authorization. No old session/profile inspection.
retrial_proposal_for_review_only.stop: On any error, uncertain outcome or cleanup failure: stop, preserve evidence and report; no automatic retry.
